Prerequisites: Engineer 4

The engineer optimizes the power output of the automaton's core, letting it use the excess power to increase its abilities in other ways. It gains a number of charges equal to the engineer's Intelligence modifier + half of his engineer level (minimum 1). These charges return automatically if not used for 8 consecutive hours. As a swift action, the engineer can command the automaton to use a swift action and expend a charge from its core reactor to gain one of the following benefits: one extra natural attack at its highest base attack bonus, a +4 dodge bonus to armor class, or increase its damage reduction by 2/—. This ability lasts until the start of the engineer's next turn.
